Title: Questions
Prompt: Write ten questions the chapter can answer. Do not write the answers yet.
Check: Each question is in the chapter.

Title: Answers
Prompt: Answer those questions from the chapter. If the chapter does not answer one, say so.

Title: Teach it
Prompt: Explain the idea as if to a classmate, using an example from the chapter. Do not import an example from another subject.
Check: The example is from the text.

Title: Confusions
Prompt: List the terms the chapter uses that it does not define.
Check: You look those up in the course, not in a guess.

Title: One-page sheet
Prompt: Make a one-page sheet of definitions and steps from the chapter. No extra topics.
Check: A classmate can see it is this chapter.

Title: Practice
Prompt: Write five practice tasks at the same level as the chapter's examples. Mark them as practice, not as official questions.
